headline: DoorDash to Acquire Instacart in $17 Billion Delivery Deal
summary: DoorDash has agreed to buy grocery delivery firm Instacart for $17 billion. The companies said the deal will expand Instacart's catalog to 150,000 stores from 100,000 currently.
why: DoorDash and Instacart are major players in the on-demand delivery sector. Large-scale consolidation alters market share, competitive dynamics, and retail partnership agreements.

impacts.name: DoorDash
impacts.why: Acquiring Instacart expands reach and catalog options, though integration risks and the $17 billion valuation affect capital.

impacts.name: Instacart
impacts.why: Acquisition terms price the company at a definitive $17 billion deal valuation.

why_moved: A multi-billion-dollar merger directly impacts equity valuations and arbitrage pricing for both delivery platforms.
